episodes.synopsis: It's the warring times of girls bands! Seven dominating forces around "CiRCLE" are fighting fierce faction battles, aiming to unify the world! The days of battles, to wash blood with blood, start again!
episodes.title: The Warring Girls Band Period

episodes.synopsis: Wow! Ideal hiking weather! But! Don't take the mountain weather for granted! It was just sunny until now. And before I realized it, we were surrounded by fog... It is important to enjoy the picnic so be careful and take all precautionary measures.
episodes.title: Hiking Hiya!

episodes.synopsis:
Let's pledge!

We, the band girls and all concerned, will uphold sportsmanship, to sweat comfortably, and to have fun fair-and-square! This is our pledge! This has been Toyama Kasumi, CiRCLE's representative!
episodes.title: In the Satisfaction of Sportsmanship

episodes.synopsis: The melancholic events that makes daily living interesting, welcome to the Spring of Emotion. At Spring of Emotion, events shared by my childhood friends that makes me glad to live, "Emoina" will comment on how to become emo. Let's start! First of all, this is "Emoina".
episodes.title: Hey! Spring of Emotion

episodes.synopsis: Terrible! Jennifer-chan has gone missing! Eh? How about a call...? Jennifer-chan can't just leave that easily, what are you talking about? ... Then, how about a mail? So, Jennifer-chan? Think seriously! I can't do this! Anyway, I'll go searching for it! My Jennifer-chan!
episodes.title: Find Jennifer!

episodes.synopsis: The rising of an enormous chain. A one-man business in distress. In order to save a certain ramen shop, the able producer CHU² and friends take action in this ramen consulting story. "Produce☆Galaxy", starting!
episodes.title: Produce☆Galaxy

episodes.synopsis: The five members of Pastel＊Palettes are going around Japan trying and challenging various things! From experimental body stretching challenges to full-scale challenges that are on par with professionals, they will make the impossible possible! Revalidate the girls bands' virtue through said challenges! There are a lot, such as "PasuPare Official Tour Street" "PasuPare Island" "PasuPare 0-Yen Cafe" "World's Most Delicious Omurice" "PasuPare Desert"!
episodes.title: THE Pastel＊Palettes DISH

episodes.synopsis: Marathon... It's one of the competitions at the school event. Some are physical tests, some are mental tests, others test friendships. Come, sweat out our youth! Run, cut through the winds! Never mind the muscle pain comes next day!
episodes.title: Running Down a Dream

episodes.synopsis: Udagawa Ako, an ordinary high school student and member of the girl band "Roselia", by a strange coincidence, comes upon a mysterious note giving off a strange aura. The notebook contains poems about a certain theme. Ako thought them to be revelations of God. And with such, she decided to lead the band girls as the Goddess of the New World. The world is shaken greatly, by Ako who had inherited the notebook's will!
episodes.title: The Black La Vie en Note

episodes.synopsis: Yesterday's live was very fun... After all, I love Morfonica...! But, after that day, everyone's seem to be distant...? H-have I done something wrong...?!
episodes.title: Mashiro the Worrywart

episodes.synopsis: The more you chew, the richer and deeper the taste that will overflow infinitely. There is a golden bird that makes a "nest" with high quality beef jerky. It is the jerky era. The era of infinite exploration of jerky!
episodes.title: Jerky Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Poppin'Party, Afterglow, Pastel*Palettes, Roselia, Hello, Happy World!, Morfonica, and RAISE A SUILEN will together prepare for the dream joint live! Great success is certain! Sparkling, heart-pounding, and everyone is happy!!... isn't it?
episodes.title: Seven Bands in a Joint Concert of Dreams!

episodes.synopsis: Roselia band members decided to hold a training camp, seeking growth. On their way, they encountered a heavy downpour. They were soaked by the time they arrived at the venue. Nobody else was there. The silence was eery. What is the fate that awaits them there...?
episodes.title: Training Camp Sonata

episodes.synopsis: Good evening... It's time for the PopiMoni Roadshow. Is tonight's order a bloody murder drama? Or spine-chilling paranormal? We have a large array of pieces to satisfy our audience. Come and enjoy the horror masterpiece tonight...
episodes.title: Poppin'Moni Movie

episodes.synopsis: The glistening sun! The clear sea! "It's a holiday on a private island today!" Everyone in Hello, Happy World! is dressed in cute swimsuits and in high spirits! "I wonder what to play next!"
episodes.title: Happy, Happy Vacation♪

episodes.synopsis: Kurata Mashiro, the client involved in an unreasonable case. Her Counsel Toyama Kasumi stands up to her defense to clear her of charges! Is she guilty or not...? It's unsure but let's just say it! "Objection!"
episodes.title: Chocolate Cornet Embezzlement

episodes.synopsis: Cat — domesticated species belonging to the Felidae family. They live independently and are oftentimes unfriendly towards their owners. But once a relationship of mutual trust is built out of deep attachment, they'll occasionally display sweet gestures that are irresistibly cute, won't they? Nyan~
episodes.title: Kitty Kitty Time

episodes.synopsis: Once upon a time, in a certain place, lived a daughter named Taederella. Everyday, Taederella was made to work hard by her Stepmother and older stepsisters. Taederella doesn't mind that, as long as she's happy and living. On a certain day, a proclamation regarding a prince from the large castle reached their place. This is where the story begins...
episodes.title: Girls Band Party Masterpiece Theatre Taederella

episodes.synopsis: Udagawa Tomoe, the usually normal high school girl. But once she sees a drums, her passion awakens!!! With powerful rivals, each brimming with their own quirks and using numerous killer techniques, a deadly fight ensues! See for yourself, the roar of Tomoe's soul!
episodes.title: Tomoe at the Arcade

episodes.synopsis:
The device was invented by the Tsurumaki Foundation. Place a thing in a room. Switch on the control panel. The thing will be transferred to another room.

episodes.title: Happy Samba Carnival

episodes.synopsis: An ordinary kindergarten that can be found anywhere. Where children's lively voices always reverberates. Where everyone have fun while playing♪ Come! Let's play today! Play in the sand? Play house? Play singing? Everyone, let's get along well and let's play together!
episodes.title: CiRCLE Kindergarten

episodes.synopsis: If you overuse your throat, like singing in a loud voice, the vocal cords may caught inflammation and it'd be difficult to even make a sound. As much as possible, refrain from vocalization, avoid stimulants, and take care of your throat.
episodes.title: Thank You

episodes.synopsis: Come! Let's all perform together! Eh...? Where are you, Marina? I want to discuss something related to the venue preparation! On that note, I haven't seen her very much lately...
episodes.title: Seven Band Joint Concert Meeting

episodes.synopsis: With Marina's resignation, which can no longer be averted, CiRCLE's survival is being threatened! In such a hopeless reality, they turn their face downwards. Among them, as one would expect, that lone girl stood up...!? The best sparkling and heart-pounding live concert begins!
episodes.title: Beyond the Distant Sky
